r1.name: Stone Vestibule
r1.hint: J: sword. E: map chest and lever.

r2.name: Relay Atrium
r2.hint: Blue opens the library; red opens the watch. Three relays power B1F.

r3.name: Copper Watch
r3.hint: Clear the watch, claim two keys, spend one at the lock.

r4.name: Weight and Light
r4.hint: Take gloves. Weight powers light; rotate the mirror from the library.

r5.name: Ancient Library
r5.hint: Move the book crate; the lever reveals a mirror. Relay waits beyond.

r6.name: Returning Runner
r6.hint: Return with boots and the lower prism signal. E then SHIFT east.

r7.name: Powder Workshop
r7.hint: B places bombs. Powder jars refill. Cracks mark a hidden stair.

r8.name: Hidden Treasury
r8.hint: Optional treasury. Bomb the copper receiver for extra supplies.

r9.name: Boots Trial
r9.hint: Flank the beetle. Heavy weight and combat unlock the boots.

r10.name: Lower Landing
r10.hint: 1F relays remain powered. Explore both lower branches.

r11.name: Magnetic Foundry
r11.hint: Mages blink along clear lines. Switch and combat unlock magnet.

r12.name: Prism Engine
r12.hint: Face east from (6,8). SPACE with magnet twice; rotate prism with E.

r13.name: Hungry Portal
r13.hint: B: place a bomb near the hungry mouth. The cleared gate is a portal.

r14.name: Threefold Circuit
r14.hint: Magnet, mirror, then E timer and SHIFT from (16,8).

r15.name: Sentinel Gallery
r15.hint: Two branch keys open the lower lock after the sentinel encounter.

r16.name: Golem Antechamber
r16.hint: Boss Key opens the seal. Refill bombs before entering.

r17.name: Ancient Golem
r17.hint: Dash anchor, bomb armor, sword core. Final phase needs BLUE crystal.

r18.name: Dawn Reservoir
r18.hint: Open the treasury and activate dawn to finish.

r19.name: Torch Shrine
r19.hint: P lights marked bowls: dawn, noon, dusk. E refills powder.

r20.name: Pot Storage
r20.hint: E lifts a pot. G throws. Carry weight onto the three-dot plate.

r21.name: Crystal Warden
r21.hint: J strikes crystal. Red reveals the Warden; blue lowers the exit.

r22.name: Hidden Sanctuary
r22.hint: Carved order: slime, bat, mask. Wrong order awakens them again.
